name: Hegymagas (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hegymagas: a blue and green shield with a crescent, a sun, a church and a bunch of grapes.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
